page.home.title: Hotel Oaza — Four-star hotel in the heart of Štip, North Macedonia
page.home.description: Hotel Oaza is a four-star hotel in the centre of Štip, North Macedonia: 57 rooms and apartments, Restaurant Mal Odmor, three event halls for up to 250 guests and the AquaBella summer resort.

hero.title: An oasisin the heartof Štip
hero.lede: Quiet rooms in oak and linen, a restaurant beneath brick arches and halls for up to 250 guests — all in a landmark terracotta tower in the centre of town.
hero.alt: The Hotel Oaza tower in Štip: a white-columned modernist building clad in faceted terracotta panels, with snow-dusted hills behind
hero.insetAlt: Apartment interior with oak desk, round mirror, cream armchair and black marble wall
booking.note: Send us your dates — we'll reply with availability and prices.
intro.statement: Oaza is Macedonian for oasis — and that is exactly what we set out to be: a calm, well-kept retreat in the middle of Štip, minutes from the old town, the Bezisten gallery and the climb to Isar Fortress.
intro.side: Behind the faceted terracotta facade you'll find a hotel run with genuine Macedonian hospitality: a reception that never closes, a kitchen that cooks the way this region likes to eat, and a team happy to help in Macedonian or English.
rooms.title: Rest, beautifully simple
rooms.lede: Fifty-seven rooms in calm, natural tones — each with air conditioning, a proper work desk, satellite TV and free Wi-Fi.

amen.label: In every room
dining.alt: Restaurant Mal Odmor: exposed brick arches, dark timber ceiling beams, white tablecloths and arched stained-glass windows
dining.title: Slow meals under brick arches
dining.body: Exposed brick arches, a timbered ceiling and stained-glass windows set the scene for traditional Macedonian dishes and European classics. Come for a long lunch, a family dinner or an unhurried evening with friends.
dining.motto: “A short break, a great satisfaction” — the house motto
dining.l3.d: Grand hall for up to 250 guests
dining.l4.d: Small hall for up to 30 guests
events.title: Three halls, every occasion
events.lede: From an intimate family lunch to a 250-guest wedding or a full-day seminar, our team takes care of the menu, the layout, the equipment — and rooms upstairs for guests travelling in.
events.wedAlt: Round banquet table with ivory linen, white hydrangeas and roses, candles and glassware
events.wed.d: Engagements, weddings, christenings and birthdays — with menus built around your day and a team that knows how a Macedonian celebration should run.
events.semAlt: Seminar layout with a long white table, notepads, water carafes and upholstered chairs beside sheer-curtained windows
events.sem.d: Projector, sound and wireless internet for trainings and seminars — with coffee breaks, lunches and overnight stays arranged in one place.

halls.sub: Capacity depends on layout — we'll suggest the best set-up for your guest list.

hall2.name: Seminar hall
hall2.uses: Seminars, trainings and presentations, with AV equipment and wireless internet.
hall3.name: Grand hall
aqua.title: Summer days by the pool
aqua.body: AquaBella is our 22,000 m² water and sports complex: three pools — with water slides and a dedicated children's pool — courts for tennis, basketball and beach volleyball, and an outdoor bar for cold drinks between swims.
aqua.small: Open in the summer season. Sports courts are free for resort visitors, 10:00–18:00. Year-round at the hotel: sauna and fitness.
stip.title: Štip, on foot
stip.body: One of Macedonia's oldest towns, Štip wraps around the hill of Isar Fortress. From our door, the old town, galleries, cafés and the university are all within easy reach — and there's pastrmajlija, the city's famous dish, to try.
stip.alt: Hotel Oaza tower rising above central Štip, with red-roofed houses climbing the hills behind
lm1.d: Medieval hilltop fortress above the city, with sweeping views over the Bregalnica valley.
lm2.d: An Ottoman-era covered market, today the city's art gallery.
lm3.d: Štip's old quarter of 19th-century townhouses and churches.
lm4.d: Thermal mineral springs and baths on the edge of town.
lm5.d: Štip's signature dish — an oval flatbread topped with cured meat, celebrated every year with its own festival.
